thread:
incidents-bot: ALERT: high error rate observed for /v1/generate (5xx + timeouts). p95 jumped from 180ms -> 2.1s, p99 -> 8.4s. Traffic: 4k rps. Auto-escalation to oncall. :rotating_light:

alice_oncall: Saw it. I'm pulling thread. Any recent deploys?

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-15T10:12Z by bob_runtime - release/optimize-multiplex v2.3.4 deployed to canary then prod at 10:15Z.

bob_runtime: Yup that was me. Canary looked fine for ~10m. Rolling to prod at 10:15.

carol_ops: Alerting customers? dave, FYI support tickets starting to spike. Eve on it?

eve_support: Yes getting a handful of 'requests time out' tickets; severity 2s piling. I posted an initial note to statuspage draft.

alice_oncall: Ok initial triage: stack shows increased request queueing on runtime-gpu pool and a tail increase in token generation latency, not immediate 5xx. Could be kvcache/eviction or batching changes in v2.3.4.

bob_runtime: We changed multiplex scheduling heuristics + slightly increased batching window from 5ms -> 12ms to improve throughput. If request mix is short-latency, that could blow up p99.

alice_oncall: Can you dump current qps per instance and queue length?

bob_runtime: Pasting quick metrics snapshot:

```
service: runtime-inference.prod
time: 2026-03-15T10:22Z
avg_qps: 4200
instances: 34
avg_queue_ms: 75
p95: 2100
p99: 8400
5xx_rate: 3.6% (baseline 0.1%)
cpu/gpu util: 78% / 62%
```

alice_oncall: 5xx are primarily upstream gateway timeouts (504) and some 500s from runtime. Correlation with new batching window seems strong.

bob_runtime: Ok revert plan: rollback canary? But prod already rolled. We should hotfix: restore batching window to 5ms or flip multiplex back. Which is fastest?

carol_ops: Network-wise everything green. No infra failures. This looks behavioral.

dave_pm: Customer impact: multiple paying customers report degraded response time; some real-time apps impacted. Recommend rapid rollback to last stable.

eve_support: I escalated top affected customers to account execs. Draft status update ready to publish once we decide root cause + mitigation.

bob_runtime: I can push a rollback to previous build (v2.3.3) that restores scheduler and batching in ~3-4 minutes. Requesting permission to rollback prod.

alice_oncall: Do it. Also enable circuit-breaker fallback to model-variant small to reduce tail if rollback has issues.

bob_runtime: Rolling back now. Command run:

```
deploy rollback --env prod --release v2.3.3 --reason "p99 timeout regression after v2.3.4"
```

deploy-bot: Rollback started: id rb-495000-01. Rolling instances down to v2.3.3. ETA ~4m.

alice_oncall: I'm watching SLO dashboard and logs. Will create a short perf trace on a couple of slow requests.

(2m later)

bob_runtime: Rollback progressing - 18/34 instances back, no errors in rollout logs.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed: id rb-495000-01. All prod instances at v2.3.3 as of 2026-03-15T10:27Z.

alice_oncall: Metrics post-rollback snapshot:

```
time: 2026-03-15T10:29Z
p95: 210ms
p99: 430ms
5xx_rate: 0.12%
avg_queue_ms: 18
```

alice_oncall: Looks back to normal range. Throttled errors dropping. Good.

dave_pm: Great. Let's run a canary again with smaller batching change and tight telemetry. Bob, do an A/B test for 10% traffic and watch p99 for 20m.

bob_runtime: Agreed. I'll open a canary with telemetry flags and revert knob to 7ms not 12ms. Also add a temporary metric for queue length per-req-type.

carol_ops: I'll keep an eye on infra and pre-warm any idle pools to minimize cold starts during canary.

eve_support: Publishing status page: "We experienced elevated timeouts affecting /v1/generate between 10:20–10:27Z due to a deployment. Services have been rolled back and are recovering." Posting now.

alice_oncall: Follow-ups: 1) postmortem to capture why canary missed tail behavior 2) tighten canary SLOs for p95/p99, simulate short request mix 3) create a kill-switch for batching window change 4) notify customers who had degraded service with timeline. Assigning owners?

bob_runtime: I'll own root cause & canary config changes.

carol_ops: I'll own infra pre-warm and rollback runbook updates.

dave_pm: I'll coordinate customer comms with Eve.

alice_oncall: Thanks team. Closing active alert. If anything reappears, re-open thread. :white_check_mark:

incidents-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: /v1/generate p99 back to normal after rollback. Incident duration ~7m. Ticket created: INC-495000 for postmortem.
